notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.58.0 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.content: [p]Hey GOALS community,[/p][p]0.58.0 brings a big focus on animation and smoother gameplay. From a new goalkeeper saving system to smarter AI and refined player movement, the pitch feel more dynamic and natural. You’ll also notice improvements to set pieces, tackling, and even the camera options. Here are some of the highlights:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Highlights[/b]:[/h2][list][*][p]New [b]goalkeeper saving system[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]stepover skill move[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Less aggressive lock-on[/b] for more natural control [/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement updates:[/b] refined acceleration, smoother dribbling, pre-trap movement, and jockey nerfs [/p][/*][*][p][b]Curve-based motion system[/b] for more natural stumbles, get-ups, and penalty run-ups[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blocking & tackling improvements[/b] including fixes, balance tweaks, and bone collision detection[/p][/*][*][p][b]Set piece upgrades[/b] with better free kick positioning and new wall behaviours[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smarter AI [/b]with improved movement, attacking/defensive logic, and signal animations[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated camera option [/b]with adjusted height and zoom[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New stepover skill move: [/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920323/f317a3490aaee8d5b0be794d7432931af9d6d222.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Full patch notes details on our [url="http://playgoals.com/en/news/patch-notes-0-58-0?utm_source=goals.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=new-team-tactics-system-with-patch-0-56-3"]website[/url].   (Coming soon)[/p][p][/p][p]Jump in, test it out, and [url="http://discord.gg/goals?utm_source=goals.beehiiv.com&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=new-team-tactics-system-with-patch-0-56-3"][i]let us know how it feels[/i][/url]. We’re building this together, see you on the pitch![/p]

notes.title: GOALS Anniversary Week 🎉
notes.content: [p][b]🎉 GOALS Anniversary Week – Let’s Celebrate! 🎉[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]Hello GOALS community! [/p][p]It’s our anniversary, and we want to say [b]a massive thank you[/b] to everyone supporting GOALS in Alpha — your feedback, ideas, and passion are helping shape the game as we build it together.  [/p][p]To celebrate, we have prepared [b]a week filled with events and giveaways[/b] for you all!   [b]🔥 Monday – Legendary+ Giveaway (First Ever!)[/b] For the first time, we’re giving away a [b]Legendary+ player[/b] to one lucky winner! 📝 How to enter:[/p][olist][*][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/goals"]Discord[/url][b] [/b][/p][/*][*][p]Go to the #giveaway channel (Community category)[/p][/*][*][p]Enter before Friday at 9 PM CEST[/p][/*][/olist][p]At the same time, we also have an[b] [/b]epic gift pack entering the store. You can claim an [b]Epic+[/b] [b]player[/b] for free during the anniversary week! [b]🎉[/b]  [b]⚽ Tuesday – Casual GOALS Tournament (7:30 PM CEST)[/b][/p][p]Those who finish in the Top 8 will win prizes, with [b]1st place[/b] taking home an [b]Epic+ Striker[/b]![/p][p]📍 Sign up[url="https://battlefy.com/playgoals/casual-goals-anniversary-august-25/689082302bf286002b498ed5/info?infoTab=details"][u] here[/u][/url] and get full details in [url="https://discord.gg/goals"]Discord[/url][b]. [/b] [/p][p][/p][p][b]🎁 Wednesday – Nitro Giveaway (1 PM CEST)[/b][/p][p]We’re giving away [b]Discord Nitro memberships[/b]! Enter via the [b]#giveaway[/b] channel.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🎲 Thursday – Gaming Night (8 PM CEST)[/b][/p][p]Join us for [b]Marbles on Stream[/b] in Discord! Each race winner will be entered in a final race to win some fantastic in-game rewards!  [/p][p]🧠 [b]Friday – Famous Friday Quiz (8 PM CEST)[/b][/p][p]For the first time, you can also win some fantastic in-game rewards for finishing in the top 3! [/p][p][/p][p]Let’s celebrate together and keep building something amazing.[/p][p][b]See you in the [/b][url="https://discord.gg/goals"]Discord[/url][b] and on the pitch![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022388/cfb285cd07665dc77a350dbc84357a0eaa56639a.png"][/img][/p]

- Player roles now correctly display on the team screen on PS5
- Resolved an issue where players could sometimes get stuck.
- Fixed low framerate occurring after whistle.
- Reduced Advantage Time from 3 seconds to 2.5 seconds for a snappier flow.
- Reducing the risk of offensive AI players falling offside

notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.57.0 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.content: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/yTbuolJ.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This one’s for the tacticians! [/p][p]0.57.0 introduces new formations and the first iteration of player roles, with unique mentalities that shape how your team behaves on the pitch. [/p][p]There’s also been a lot of work under the hood: smarter AI, tighter controls, cleaner animations. The kind of stuff you feel more than see. [/p][p]Check out the latest on Alpha. [/p][p]Build GOALS with us.[/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights:[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved through passes, lofted pass/cross trajectories, and pass selection. [/p][/*][*][p]Tuned movement, shooting, ball speed and skill moves. [/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked second player press, call player short, interceptions, and open goal aim assist. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked blocking with new movement and animations. [/p][/*][*][p]Faster stumbles, and tweaked shoulder barge.[/p][/*][*][p]Offensive and defensive AI is now more coordinated and positionally aware. [/p][/*][*][p]Player roles added, with a set of special mentalities. [/p][/*][*][p]Three new formations added. [/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked gameplay cameras. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Player Roles: [/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/70BOMWR.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Full list of patch notes can be found on our [url="https://playgoals.com/en/news/patch-notes-0-57-0"]website[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Jump in, test it out, and [i]let us know how it feels[/i]. See you on the pitch![/p]

- Improved through passes, lofted pass/cross trajectories, and pass selection
- Tuned movement, shooting, ball speed, and skill moves
- Tweaked second player press, call player short, interceptions and open goal aim assist
- Reworked blocking with new movement and animations
- Faster stumbles, and tweaked shoulder barge
- Offensive and defensive AI more coordinated and positionally aware
- Player roles added, with a set of special mentalities
- Three new formations added
- Tweaked gameplay cameras

Patch notes:
- Buffed driven pass trap cooldown
- Buffed trap reactions after post bounces
- Nerfed shot dispersion on long-range finesse shots
- Improved ball avoidance logic
- Increased passivity timer speed from 2 m/s to 3 m/s
- Stand tackles that result in penalties will no longer trigger automatic red cards for last defender
- Fixed issue with main menu navigation

Patch notes:
Removed stun effect when receiving driven passes
Fixed issue where inputs sometimes didn’t register during set pieces
Capped camera offset distance on free kicks for better visibility
Lock-on: Removed shooter priority after post bounces; all players now react instantly
Removed grace period on user-triggered runs (was previously added to prevent kick-off glitch)
Fixed an issue where some usernames could prevent players from joining matches

notes.title: Sending out invites to Latin America this weekend!
notes.content:
Latin America has hosted the World Cup five times and claimed the trophy twice as many. The world knows their skill on the pitch, now let’s see how it translates to GOALS.

If you’re in Latin America, make sure to join us on Steam by the 31st to get your invite.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022388/e279e5e73f78747adf7c8b8c5d3df2c937e99b09.png[/img]

notes.title: EUROPE YOU'RE IN!
notes.content:
We’re sending out playtest invites to all European countries on October 25th and 26th! This is your chance to test GOALS in its pre-alpha stage and provide us with valuable feedback to help shape the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022388/2cc6ce3463e10ae601639b072ee4b3c566b57f93.png[/img]

Haven’t signed up yet? Request playtest access now!

notes.title: 🚨 Release 0.40.0 is LIVE! 🚨
notes.content:
Hey GOALS community,

We’re excited to announce that Patch 0.40.0 is now live, bringing a host of new features and improvements to elevate your gameplay! With smarter AI, new animations, and enhanced visual effects, every match feels more immersive and strategic. From slide tackles and preferred foot logic to fully implemented goalkeepers, this update adds more depth and excitement to the pitch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022388/b0da3d7fc39024d04ef4d9ee5b584b62db41519e.png[/img]

Check out the full patch notes on our Discord for more detailed changes.

notes.title: Invites Incoming
notes.content:
🚨 The moment you’ve been waiting for is here! ⁠🚨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022388/17db66aaf278a95805726c04060ba8b27013047d.png[/img]

We’re sending out playtest invites this weekend to everyone registered on Steam from France, Germany, Spain, Portugal, and the UK. ⁠🎮
⁠
If you haven’t signed up yet, make sure to do so before Thursday, October 17th.
⁠
